messages.text: Hi, do you offer international shipping?

Hi,

Yes, we ship worldwide. We serve the US, Canada, Europe, the UK and the rest of the world, including Australia and New Zealand.

A few things worth knowing. Miners ship with the plug and voltage matched to your region, so you get the right unit for where you are. Orders going to Europe ship from our Netherlands warehouse with import VAT included in the price, so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery. UK orders may be subject to VAT and import duties on arrival, which are the recipient's responsibility. US and Canadian orders have no import VAT or duty; sales tax is added at checkout where it applies.

Shipping cost itself is calculated from your address at checkout, so you will see the exact figure before you pay.

If you tell me which country you are in and which unit you have your eye on, I will confirm exactly what it costs to get it to you and when it ships.

Sarah

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the honest response. I completely understand, and I respect that
you already have your marketing and video production handled internally.

The reason I reached out wasn't simply to offer another marketing service,
but to explore whether I could bring an additional perspective to what your
team is already doing.

For a specialized store like HeliumDeploy, I see an opportunity to combine
targeted product research with short-form video creatives that help
potential buyers understand the value of your miners, see how they fit
their needs, and feel more confident before making a purchase.

Rather than asking you to change your current approach or commit to a
service, I'd be happy to put together a few tailored creative concepts for
HeliumDeploy that your team could review and potentially use as inspiration
for future campaigns.

If the ideas offer something useful, we could explore whether there's room
to collaborate. If not, there's absolutely no obligation.

Would you be open to me sharing two or three ideas specifically tailored to
your store?

Best regards,
Jerry

Hi Jerry,

Thanks for the follow up, and for taking the no graciously. The answer is still no, though. We're not reviewing creative concepts or pitches at the moment, so sending ideas over wouldn't lead anywhere and I'd rather not have you spend the time on it.

I'll close this one out here. If anything changes on our side, we'd reach out.

All the best,
Sarah
